channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Trump Effort to Prove Rampant Noncitizen Voting Leads to Few Charges So Far
item.description: Just 236 people have been charged with voting-fraud-related offenses by the Trump administration, despite its unsubstantiated claims that fraud is widespread.

item.title: NPR: When caring for aging family members becomes cost prohibitive
item.description: AARP reports family caregivers are spending 60% more than they were five years ago. Journalist Paula Span discusses the rising costs of caregiving and senior living, and the options available to us.

item.title: BBC News: How the US midterm results could unfold - as millions of Americans head to the polls
item.description: The BBC's North America correspondent considers three different scenarios, and what they would mean for the country.

item.title: The Guardian: ‘I perfected deception’: My secret life as a relapsed alcoholic | Meghan O'Gieblyn
item.description: Everyone knew about my years of addiction, the dangers I had put myself in. The second time around, after 11 years sober, not even my husband knew I am finding it very hard to write about my return to drinking. This is u…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Darfur survivors vow to tell story of those killed after Sudan camp attacks
item.description: Survivors of attacks on displacement camps in Darfur recall the lives they built, and violence that forced them to flee.

item.title: Ars Technica: Google dismantles botnet secretly running on 1.3 million Android TV boxes
item.description: Google has cut ties with the company behind the botnet campaign.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: ‘Our Risk, Their Reward’: Zohran Mamdani on AI and Data Centers
item.description: Ahead of the midterms, WIRED talked to New York City’s mayor about data centers, AI in schools, and the future of the Democratic party.

item.title: WIRED Science: NASA’s Swift Observatory Is Falling to Earth. Here’s What to Know About the Impending Impact
item.description: The 3,200-pound satellite is expected to reenter Earth’s atmosphere later this week with a wide reentry zone covering parts of Africa, Australia, Southeast Asia, and South America.

item.title: WIRED Business: Meta’s Muse Could Upend All Kinds of Businesses. It Hasn’t Yet
item.description: Companies have spent the past several weeks trying to reassure investors that Muse and other AI agents pose more of an opportunity than a threat.

item.title: The New Yorker: Finally, the Beginning of Trump’s End
item.description: Reflections on a midterm campaign in which our octogenarian President waged war—against algae in the Reflecting Pool.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Haley Stevens Doesn’t Want You to Blame Her Fiancé
item.description: She’s an independent woman who blew up her career all on her own, okay?

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: What Do New York City’s Ballot Proposals Mean?
item.description: A brief guide to the infrastructure and streetscape questions on the slate.
